snippet.title: Bug Heroes Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description: The cinematic, pre-release trailer for Bug Heroes, an upcoming dual stick shooter/RPG/castle defense game by Foursaken Media, creators of N.Y.Zombies for the iPhone and iPod Touch. Follow us on Twitter to stay up to date with all the latest screenshots, gameplay videos, and game details!
